flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck); status_with_ura blank (requirement not given)
code_summary: No code for resending court memos. Only unused TypeScript types in ocmsadminui (utils/models/Itemplatecourtmemo.d.ts, Ibatchsummoncsmemo.d.ts) and the ocms_court_case entity (OcmsCourtCase), which holds only court_payment_due_date and reason. CasIntegrationController has only the 4 CAS-to-OCMS endpoints (payment status, update court notices, court case info, payment activation). ToppanUploadJob handles DN/AN notice letters only, not court memos.
note: Story status is blank (requirement not given), traced normally. Synonyms tried: court memo, courtmemo, charge sheet, court summons, summon, csmemo, batch summon, resend, re-send, returned summons, address change, vendor, Toppan, across all six repos (UI and API). Result: no controller, service, repository, cron or UI page resends a court memo, merges memo + summons + charge sheet into a PDF, or sends it to a vendor. The types Ibatchsummoncsmemo (summon_pdf, cs_pdf, memo_pdf) and Itemplatecourtmemo are only declarations in ocmsadminui, imported by no component, with no matching entity/table in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi. CAS inbound endpoints are not credited because none performs a step of the story. State Courts SFTP, court batches, work items and court reports are already known to be absent from these six repos. No relevant maintenance ticket: OCMS-DF-2026-194 (court reports) only mentions new court reports generally and is still Open; it is not about resending court memos.
recommendation: Not claimed: no code for resending court memos to a vendor. Confirm whether it is built in the CAS/State Courts system outside the six repos.

steps.step: Court Processing Officer uses OCMS to confirm the registered address of the company/individual on the sent court summons has not changed
steps.detail: No code checks address changes for returned court summonses. The ocms_court_case entity (OcmsCourtCase.java:18-32) only stores notice_no, court_payment_due_date and reason. Synonyms tried: returned summons, address change, registered address, summons and MHA/DataHive in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui: the existing address checks belong to the DN/AN notice flow (mha_reg, lta_reg), not to court summonses. Cannot verify from repo whether this check happens in CAS.

steps.step: OCMS gives the officer an option to resend the court memo
steps.detail: No button, page or API for resending a court memo. In ocmsadminui there are only the type declarations Itemplatecourtmemo (Itemplatecourtmemo.d.ts:1-10) and Ibatchsummoncsmemo (Ibatchsummoncsmemo.d.ts:1-18, fields memo_pdf, court_memo_desc), imported by no page; grep csmemo/courtmemo/summoncs only hits the type files, History.tsx, REPCCSDetail.tsx, useSearch.ts and translation.json without any resend action. No matching backend entity or endpoint. CasIntegrationController (4 inbound CAS endpoints) does not resend and is not credited.

steps.step: OCMS merges the court memo with the court summons and charge sheet into one PDF file
steps.detail: No code merges a court memo + summons + charge sheet PDF. Ibatchsummoncsmemo.d.ts:1-18 only declares summon_pdf, cs_pdf, memo_pdf on the UI side; no batch summon entity/table, service or cron in ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi fills or merges them. The existing letter generator (Toppan) produces files for notice stages, not court. Cannot verify from repo whether the merge happens in CAS/State Courts.

steps.step: OCMS sends the PDF to the vendor for printing and postage (normal post)
steps.detail: A vendor delivery mechanism (Toppan SFTP) exists in ToppanUploadJob.java:38-48, but it is called by ToppanLettersGeneratorJob for notice letter stages and the class has no court/summons/memo reference (grep empty). Under the consistency rule a generic mechanism that is not the feature the story names is not credited, and there is no resend-court-memo trigger. The court vendor and State Courts SFTP are not in the repo; cannot verify from repo.
